subject.title: feat: add jsonl support to memory indexer

question: Should builtin memory core accept arbitrary JSONL files in `memorySearch.extraPaths`, or should structured raw-log ingestion be owned by a separate memory plugin/workflow?
rationale: The current Markdown-only contract is deliberate across several runtime surfaces, and the safe JSONL behavior depends on maintainer choices about record schema, searchable fields, secret/privacy handling, and ongoing ownership.

options.title: Use a dedicated memory plugin
options.body: Keep builtin extra paths Markdown-oriented and define structured-log ingestion in a separately owned memory plugin using the existing memory plugin slot.

options.title: Extend builtin memory core
options.body: Adopt JSONL as a supported builtin input format with an explicit schema, field-selection, security, retrieval, watcher, documentation, and upgrade contract.

recommendation.title: Use a dedicated memory plugin
recommendation.body: Keep builtin extra paths Markdown-oriented and define structured-log ingestion in a separately owned memory plugin using the existing memory plugin slot.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has already provided maintainer-side context on the remaining builtin memory boundary and is closely connected to the relevant code paths.
